welcome: Complete these steps securely. No account is needed.
alreadyDoneBody: This link has already been completed. There is nothing more to do.
unavailableBody: It may have expired or been withdrawn. Please ask the gym for a new link.
failed: We couldn't complete that step. Please try again or contact the gym.
conflict: Something changed. Reload this page and review the latest details before continuing.
customerMissing: Card setup isn't available yet. Please contact the gym.
tabletHelp: Hand the tablet to the signer. This page clears after two minutes without activity.
clearedBody: Return the tablet to the front desk for the next person.
paymentPending: Your payment is being confirmed. Please check again shortly.
cardHelp: Enter your card on Stripe's secure page. Your card will be saved for future gym payments.
noWaivers: There are no documents waiting to be signed.
guardian: A parent or guardian must sign for this member.
guardianOption: I am a parent or guardian
signatureHelp: Use your finger, mouse, or pen in the box, or upload a PNG signature image.
signatureRequired: Please draw or upload your signature first.
consent: I have read this document and agree to sign it.
incomplete: Complete the card step and any unsigned documents, then check again. Card confirmation may take a moment.
doneBody: Thank you. Your details have been received.
javascript: Please enable JavaScript to complete this page.
completed_onboarding: Your card details and required documents have been saved. Thank you.
completed_update_card: Your card has been saved. Thank you.
completed_pay_invoice: Your payment has been confirmed. Thank you.
completed_sign_waiver: Your signed document has been saved. Thank you.
portalHelp: Optional: create portal access before you finish your final step. This link closes when your card details and required documents are complete.
portalPassword: Password (12–128 characters; use your current password if you already have an account)
portalReady: Your portal access is ready. Sign in using this email after completing the remaining steps.
portalEmailSent: Check your email. Open the sign-in link we sent before you finish the remaining steps here: it confirms the address and completes your portal access.
